answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short. The summit holds work receipts rather than names, so the pigment of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
